positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: In GrowSF's questionnaire his answer called Mayor Lurie's Family Zoning plan a step in the right direction but not ambitious enough by itself, and said future housing growth must be shared across every San Francisco neighborhood.

citations.quote: Mayor Lurie’s Family Zoning plan is a step in the right direction, but by itself it is not ambitious enough to solve San Francisco’s housing challenges.
citations.locator: Housing: "Do you think Mayor Lurie’s Family zoning plan is too ambitious or not ambitious enough?"

citations.quote: District 10 has carried more than its fair share of new development over the years, so future housing growth must be equitable across every neighborhood in San Francisco.
citations.locator: Housing: "Do you think Mayor Lurie’s Family zoning plan is too ambitious or not ambitious enough?"
